summary: Horace Mann Educators Corporation filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, announcing completion of its previously announced acquisition of all outstanding membership interests of Employee Services, LLC (ESI) from Medical Mutual of Ohio. The all-cash transaction is valued at $115 million, subject to customary purchase price adjustments, and ESI became a wholly owned Horace Mann subsidiary. ESI provides employee assistance programs, including confidential counseling and work-life resources, complementing Horace Mann's insurance and financial offerings to school districts. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The deal closed upon filing; watch integration execution and purchase-price adjustment true-up.
